
=== WebPanel: WWPBaseObjects.Subscriptions.WWP_SubscriptionsSettingsByRole ===

--- Start (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Cell_Grid_DWC.Class = !'Invisible WCD_' + upper(Grid.InternalName)
	
	Grid.Rows = 50
	Grid_Empowerer.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	Form.Caption = "Manage Role's Subscriptions"
	Do 'LoadGridState'
	GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue = Grid.Rows
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */
	Form.Caption = Format("Subscriptions for Role: %1", WWPGetRoleName(&WWPSubscriptionRoleId))

--- Refresh (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	Do 'SaveGridState'
	&GridCurrentPage = Grid.CurrentPage
	//&GridPageCount has to be loaded manually
	&GridAppliedFilters = WWP_GetAppliedFiltersDescription(&Pgmname)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridPaginationBar.ChangePage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Previous'
			Grid.PreviousPage()
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Next'
			Grid.NextPage()
		Otherwise
			&PageToGo.FromString(GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage)
			Grid.GotoPage(&PageToGo)
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridPaginationBar.ChangeRowsPerPage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Grid.Rows = GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue
	Grid.FirstPage()
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Grid.Load (Event) ---
&GridRecordCount = 0
	For Each WWP_Entity
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	//this code should be inside the For Each used to load the data
	
	//Sample conditions to be added manually:
	//Where <Attribute> = &NotifShowOnlySubscribedEvents when not &NotifShowOnlySubscribedEvents.IsEmpty()
	
	&DetailWebComponent = !'<i class="fas fa-angle-right ArrowIcon"></i>'
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */
		&WWPEntityName = WWPEntityName
		&WWPEntityId = WWPEntityId
		&EntityHasItemsToShow = False
		&NotificationsForEntityCount = Count(WWPNotificationDefinitionDescription, WWPNotificationDefinitionAppliesTo = Notifications.WWP_NotificationAppliesTo.AnyRecord)
		If &NotificationsForEntityCount > 0 And Not &NotifShowOnlySubscribedEvents
			&EntityHasItemsToShow = True
		Else
			&SubscriptionsForEntityCount = Count(WWPSubscriptionSubscribed, WWPSubscriptionRoleId = &WWPSubscriptionRoleId)
			If &SubscriptionsForEntityCount > 0
				&EntityHasItemsToShow = True
			EndIf
		EndIf
		If &EntityHasItemsToShow
			&GridRecordCount += 1
			Load
		EndIf
		
	EndFor
	&GridPageCount = &GridRecordCount/Grid.Rows + iif(Mod(&GridRecordCount, Grid.Rows) > 0, 1, 0)

--- &DetailWebComponent.Click (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Grid_DWC.Object = WWP_SubscriptionsSettingsByRoleWC.Create(&WWPEntityId, &NotifShowOnlySubscribedEvents, &WWPSubscriptionRoleId)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- &NotifShowOnlySubscribedEvents.Click (Event) ---
Grid_DWC.Refresh()

--- Rules (Rules) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

parm(in:&WWPSubscriptionRoleId);

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

=== Procedure: WWPBaseObjects.WWPGetRoleName ===

--- Source (Source) ---
&GAMRole = GAMRole.GetByGUID(&WWPSubscriptionRoleId, &GAMErrorCollection)
&RoleName = &GAMRole.Name

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(in:&WWPSubscriptionRoleId, out:&RoleName);


=== Procedure: WWPBaseObjects.WWP_GetUserEmail ===

--- Source (Source) ---
&GAMUser = GAMRepository.GetUserByGUID(&WWPUserExtendedId, &GAMErrorCollection)
&WWPUserExtendedEmail = &GAMUser.EMail

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(in:&WWPUserExtendedId, out:&WWPUserExtendedEmail);


=== Procedure: WWPBaseObjects.WWP_GetUserFullName ===

--- Source (Source) ---
&GAMUser = GAMRepository.GetUserByGUID(&WWPUserExtendedId, &GAMErrorCollection)
&WWPUserExtendedFullName = iif(&GAMUser.FirstName.IsEmpty(), &GAMUser.Name, &GAMUser.FirstName.Trim() + " " + &GAMUser.LastName.Trim())

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(in:&WWPUserExtendedId, out:&WWPUserExtendedFullName);


=== Procedure: WWPBaseObjects.WWP_GetUserPhone ===

--- Source (Source) ---

&WWPUserExtendedPhone = &GAMUser.Phone

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(in:&WWPUserExtendedId, out:&WWPUserExtendedPhone);
